enforcement.enforce: Enforce: the server refuses further writes
enforcement.diskHelp: Enforce needs user quotas on the sites filesystem. Disk use is checked every hour.
enforcement.block: Block: websites show a 503 page until the month ends
enforcement.bandwidthHelp: 0 GB means no limit. Usage resets on the first day of each month.
enforcement.phpHelp: For the account's websites' PHP, all its sites together. 100% CPU is one full core; 0 means no limit. With a limit, the account's PHP runs in its own PHP-FPM, so it cannot slow other accounts down. Needs a Linux server with systemd; applied within five minutes.
enforcement.mailHelp: Outgoing mail from the account's mailboxes and websites, each recipient counted once. 0 means no limit. Over the limit, mail is held back until the hour or day is over (website mail waits in the queue, mail apps are asked to try later) and the account is notified. Needs the Rspamd module.
